newsitem.title: UK: Jamaica expected to launch $100 mln five-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica expected to launch $100 mln five-year bond.

text.p: Jamaica is expected to launch a $100 million five-year bond following investor presentations in Europe, bankers said on Monday.
Unofficial price talk is in the low to mid-300 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
Bankers Trust will lead manage this first international bond for the country but declined to comment on the transaction.

During the 1996-97 budget debate last year, Finance Minister Omar Davies said the government intended to raise $190 million in overseas markets. He reiterated the government's commitment to raise capital abroad during this year's budget debate in March.
The government intends to use the funds raised to reduce the cost of servicing domestic debt.
